Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649963. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter by assay_chembl_id CHEMBL4649963, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
